canon: Cardo espinoso de tallo rígido (unos 25 cm) rematado en una flor cerrada de un gris metálico apagado con matiz violáceo (decisión de la usuaria, 2026-10-25; el ítem dice «morado apagado»). Su fibra central rígida se vuelve una aguja imantada: colgada de un hilo, gira hasta señalar siempre el mismo rumbo. Crece en Las Agujas Imán, al abrigo de las rocas, donde se acumula la arena imantada.
fuentes: backend/src/scripts/worldCatalog.ts:6939-6946 (ítem: tallo espinoso, flor cerrada de morado apagado, tallo de 25 cm); backend/src/scripts/worldCatalog.ts:47-60 (Las Agujas Imán); docs/rpgtarkor/lore-mundo/regiones/llanuras-del-viento-rojo.md:158-166 (fibra central imantada) y 546-564 (Agujas Imán, rocas flotantes)

prompt.sujeto: A small, rigid thistle seen from ground level, its thick spiny stem twisted like rope and topped by a single large closed bud, with a few stiff, narrow, blade-like leaves curling out from the base.
prompt.proporcion: The bud is two thirds as tall as the stem and twice as wide, and the whole plant rises only a little above the stones around it.
prompt.cuerpo: The bud is built like a closed artichoke from overlapping charcoal-grey blade-scales with a faint violet tint, their edges glinting silver, and the stem is the same dull grey, studded with short sharp thorns.
rasgos: From the tip of each bud a single fine, stiff filament arches out and points the same way as all the others, toward the left of the image.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: Fine grey burrs crowd the stem just below each bud, and tiny grains of black sand cling along the thorns.
prompt.pose: The horizon lies a third of the way up the image; the nearest plant fills the lower left foreground, sharp and large, and a loose diagonal row of smaller ones runs back toward the middle ground, softer with each step.
prompt.entorno: They grow in the lee of glossy black rocks, where dark grains drift against red sand. Black needle spires fill the right half of the middle ground with small black stones hanging still above them, and flat-topped red mesas, an eighth of the image tall, fade into haze under a wide amber sky.
prompt.luz: Low warm amber light falls from the right through a light haze, picking out the silver edges of the scales and the thorns, and casting long soft shadows to the left across the sand.

momento:atardecer.luz: Warm low evening light falls from behind with a gentle backlight, rimming the silver edges of the scales and the thorns, and casting long soft shadows across the sand.

momento:noche.luz: A soft, even pearly glow under the stars gently outlines the silver edges of the scales and the thorns, and deep cool shadows pool across the sand.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore
choca con el banner, sigue al canon: planta pequeña (tallo de 25 cm), vista a ras de suelo para que llene el plano; el banner y la ficha anterior la hacían de dos metros

choca con el banner, sigue al canon: el paisaje es el de Las Agujas Imán (rocas negras brillantes de arena compactada, agujas y piedras suspendidas), no el acantilado rojo del banner; las mesetas del horizonte sí se quedan
del banner y fuera del canon: yema como una alcachofa de escamas en hoja gris carbón con bordes plateados; tallo retorcido como una cuerda
filamento que sale de la yema y señala el mismo rumbo en todas las plantas: lectura visual de la fibra central imantada (el canon la sitúa dentro, al colgarla de un hilo), no canon
las rosetas lanosas verde plata del primer plano del banner se quitan: no hay planta así en Las Agujas Imán

capas.notas: IMG-54, plantilla por capas (scripts/capas.py): forma sin color en los campos de lápiz; color, paleta y luz solo en el paso a foto. Del estudio: el uso (colgada de un hilo) no se describe, se pinta; los materiales comparados (wrought iron, bent wire) sí cambian la forma; «faint violet tint» da lila pastel.
capas.sujeto: A patch of spiky thistles sheltered at the foot of tall rocks, seen from low on the ground. The nearest thistle stands in the right half, rising from the bottom edge to two thirds of the image height.
capas.tamano: Its stem is as thick as a wrist, and its single closed bud is as big as a melon, far bigger than any common thistle.
capas.forma: The stem is gnarled and twisted like wrought iron and bristles with long thorns. The bud is like a spiky artichoke made of overlapping pointed scales of hammered metal, their tips curling outward like blades. From the tip of the bud one long thin stiff fibre curls up like a bent wire and points to the left.
capas.entorno: Smaller thistles of the same kind grow on the left, smaller with distance, each with the same stiff fibre pointing the same way to the left. Drifts of fine sand gather against the rocks around their roots. Behind them, tall rock walls on the right, and on the left a wide plain with flat-topped mesas in the distance.
capas.color: The bud scales are a dull metallic grey like old pewter, the stem dark iron-grey, the fibre black. The sand around the roots is dark grey, almost black, and glints faintly. The rocks, the plain and the far mesas are red.
capas.paleta: pewter grey and rust red under a pale sky
capas.luz: Clear daylight from high on the right with a light warm haze, short shadows.
